description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』に登場のガミラス艦「クリピテラ級」「ケルカピア級」「デストリア級」の3体セットが1/1000スケールで！
description.en: A 1/1000 Scale set of three Garmillas ships "Kripitera class ", " Kelucapia class " and " Destria class " that appeared in " Space Battleship Yamato 2202"!

description.ja: • 精密なディテールでガミラス艦を再現！
description.en: • Reproduce the Garmillas ship with precise details!

description.ja: • 艦首両舷開口部は、クリアパーツと水転写式デカールで発光を再現。
description.en: • The openings on both sides of the bow reproduce light emission using clear parts and water transfer decals.

description.ja: • 航行時の再現ができる蛍光色パーツと停泊時が再現できるパーツの2種が付属。
description.en: • Two types of parts are included: fluorescent colored parts that can reproduce when sailing and parts that can reproduce when anchored.

description.ja: • ディスプレイベース用の艦名シールが付属。
description.en: • Ship name seal for display base is included.
